revise_description: To reflect new parental rules and budget control, introduce a two-day trip with separate day-1 and day-2 child selections plus a bonus indicator per child for attending both days. Add daily min/max and relationship constraints for each day, enforce that Charlie and Diana appear only on day 2, limit total distinct children over both days by max_distinct_children_trip, cap total cost by total_cost_budget, and require at least min_bob_days days for Bob. Objective now minimizes total two-day cost minus total bonus_saving applied to children present on both days.
